name: quality
description: Code quality operations: pre-commit checks, auto-fix, and validation.
when_to_use: Before commit, after code changes, to fix lint/format/type errors or run validation (schema, roadmap_sync).
troubleshooting_tips: Run execute_pre_commit_checks(checks=["quality"]) to get lint, format, type_check in one call.
If fix_quality_issues fails with connection error, retry once; then rely on execute_pre_commit_checks.
